queries: WITH per_tel AS (SELECT telescref, AVG(modindex) AS avg_mod FROM signals GROUP BY telescref HAVING AVG(modindex) IS NOT NULL), overall AS (SELECT AVG(avg_mod) AS overall_avg FROM per_tel), above AS (SELECT p.telescref, p.avg_mod, o.overall_avg FROM per_tel p CROSS JOIN overall o WHERE p.avg_mod > o.overall_avg), above_mean AS (SELECT AVG(avg_mod) AS above_avg FROM above) SELECT a.telescref, a.avg_mod AS avg_modindex, a.avg_mod - a.overall_avg AS diff_from_overall, a.avg_mod / m.above_avg AS ratio_to_above_mean FROM above a CROSS JOIN above_mean m ORDER BY ratio_to_above_mean DESC LIMIT 10

assumptions.assumption: Telescopes whose modindex values are all NULL have no average and are excluded from the overall mean of per-telescope averages.
The ratio's denominator is the mean of the per-telescope averages of the above-average telescopes (each counted once), computed over all of them before the top 10 limit is applied.
